prompt: You apologised sincerely for letting a friend down, but they say they are not ready to forgive you yet. What response most respects them while keeping the door open?

options.text: Keep apologising every day until they give in and say it is fine
Tell them they are being unfair, since you have already said sorry properly
Cut them off completely for rejecting your apology
Accept their answer without pressure, say you understand and will be here when they are ready, then give them space

explanation: Forgiveness cannot be demanded on your timetable. Accepting their pace shows the apology was about their hurt, not just easing your guilt, while repeated pressure makes an apology feel like another demand.
